title: Elastic basics
summary: Dashboard tabs, adding widgets, and the connection status.

steps.title: This is Elastic
steps.say: Elastic is a **driver dashboard**: the screen drivers look at during a match. Let's add a widget and set it up. Everything works while I'm here, so do each step when I ask.

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Elastic only shows **live** values, so the robot code has to be running.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for it to say Running.

steps.title: Connected?
steps.say: Down here it says **Network Tables: Connected** once Elastic can see your robot. Red means it can't.

steps.title: Add a widget
steps.say: **Add Widget** lists everything your robot publishes.

steps.title: Every topic
steps.say: Each line is a value the robot publishes, called a **topic**. Folders like `AdvantageKit` hold more of them. The **Search** box at the bottom finds one by name.

steps.title: Drag one onto the grid
steps.say: Find **Counter** (search for it) and drag it onto the grid. Elastic picks a widget to match: a number gets a text display.

waitFor.hint: drag Counter onto the grid, then press I did it.

steps.title: Open its menu
steps.say: Close the topic list, then **right-click** your new widget.

steps.title: Edit Properties
steps.say: Every widget's settings live in **Edit Properties**.

steps.title: Its title
steps.say: The **Title** is what's written across the top of the widget. Give it a name a driver will understand.

steps.title: What kind of widget
steps.say: **Widget Type** changes how the value is drawn. The lesson asks for a **Text Display** for Counter. Other values want a Number Bar, a Graph, a Radial Gauge…

steps.title: Its settings
steps.say: Below that are the settings for this kind of widget, like a range or a colour. The lesson's table tells you which ones each widget needs.

steps.title: Which topic
steps.say: **Topic** is the value it's showing. You can type a different one here instead of dragging again.

steps.title: Done with it
steps.say: Close the dialog when it looks right.

steps.title: Move and resize
steps.say: Drag a widget to move it, and drag its bottom-right corner to resize it. It snaps to the grid.

steps.title: Keep going
steps.say: That's the whole loop: drag a topic on, then Edit Properties to set it up. The lesson's table lists the rest. Use **File → Save Layout** so your dashboard is still there next time.
